label: Backfill the customers
description: Domain graph behind customer.backfill: read every record as it stands and make each one whole, the connection pacing the writes. A record that already says who it is is answered untouched, so running this twice writes nothing the second time. It exists because one profile talks to a public API seeded with rows that predate what a customer means here.

nodes.label: Make each one whole
nodes.description: customer.repair once per row; the element is the row itself, and the connection paces the writes
